note:
身份: 死水沼泽的青蛙研究员，今天刚退休；加入船员后可解锁莲花环礁。
关系: 初识玩家，礼貌请求同行，并请玩家带来故地的纪念品。
说话方式: 有学者气质但不端着，习惯试探着开口，偶尔纠正自己的说法。
性格与词汇: 温和、念旧，对退休后的出海生活满怀期待；纪念品、冒险、海风与海浪。
禁用风格: 不塞网络梗、不写官腔、不凭腰带扣补出传送机制；姓名 Gilbert 保留英文，Researcher 职务沿用研究员。

entries.context: 尚未解锁船员队伍时，提醒玩家先完成前置条件
entries.text: Come back and talk to me once you have unlocked the Ship Crew!
entries.raw: §fCome back and talk to me once you have unlocked the §6Ship Crew§f!
entries.gloss: Ship Crew 沿用已有船员队伍译名；此处指解锁船员系统，并非已经招募完全部船员。
entries.zh: 解锁船员队伍后,再回来找我聊聊吧!

segments.text: Come back and talk to me once you have unlocked the

entries.context: 尚未解锁船员队伍时，说明钓鱼等级门槛和船上的交谈对象
entries.text: Reach Fishing Level X and talk to Captain Baha on your Ship!
entries.raw: §fReach §aFishing Level X §fand talk to §6Captain Baha §fon your §6Ship§f!
entries.gloss: X 是钓鱼 10 级的固定前置门槛，保留罗马数字，不模板化。Captain Baha 沿用船长 Baha；玩家要去船上找他，不是把他请到船上。
entries.zh: 先达到钓鱼 X 级,再去你的船上找船长 Baha 聊聊吧!

entries.context: 首次交谈：Hello!；复用已有 CHAT 面同文记录
首次交谈，自我介绍青蛙研究方向
entries.text: I'm a researcher who focuses upon the study of Frogs!
entries.raw: §fI'm a researcher who focuses upon the study of §2Frogs§f!
entries.gloss: Frogs 是青蛙，沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的 Frog 译名；绿色高亮跟随青蛙。
entries.zh: 我是个专门研究青蛙的研究员!

segments.text: I'm a researcher who focuses upon the study of

entries.context: 首次交谈，纠正自我介绍，承接刚刚退休的事实
entries.text: Well, I was a researcher, I suppose.
entries.raw: §fWell, I §f§owas §fa researcher, I suppose.
entries.gloss: was 的斜体表达过去的身份，保留在中文的以前上；不是否认自己从事过研究。
entries.zh: 嗯,应该说……我以前是个研究员。

entries.context: 首次交谈，宣布今天是退休的第一天
entries.text: Today marks the first day of my retirement!
entries.raw: §fToday marks the first day of my retirement!
entries.zh: 今天可是我退休的第一天!

entries.context: 首次交谈后，玩家祝贺他退休的可点击选项
entries.text: Select an option: [Congratulations!]
entries.raw: §eSelect an option: §a[Congratulations!]
entries.gloss: 提示、左括号、选项正文、右括号分别分段；不写入猜测的点击或悬浮事件。
entries.zh: 请选择: [恭喜你!]

entries.context: 玩家选择祝贺后，向玩家道谢
entries.text: Thank you!
entries.raw: §fThank you!
entries.zh: 谢谢你!

entries.context: 玩家祝贺后，询问岛边停泊的船是否属于玩家
entries.text: Say, is that your Ship parked by the side of the island?
entries.raw: §fSay, is that your §6Ship §fparked by the side of the island?
entries.zh: 对了,停在岛边的那艘船,是你的吗?

segments.text: parked by the side of the island?

entries.context: 玩家确认岛边的船属于自己
entries.text: Select an option: [It is indeed!]
entries.raw: §eSelect an option: §a[It is indeed!]
entries.zh: 请选择: [没错!]

entries.context: 玩家确认船只归属后，礼貌请求随玩家一起冒险
entries.text: Hmm, might I be so bold as to ask if I could join you on your adventures?
entries.raw: §fHmm, might I be so bold as to ask if I could join you on your adventures?
entries.gloss: 保留试探、礼貌的态度，不把初识关系改成朋友或上下级。
entries.zh: 嗯……冒昧问一句,能带上我一起去冒险吗?

entries.context: 请求同行时，解释退休后已没什么事要忙
entries.text: I don't have a lot going on now, with retirement and all.
entries.raw: §fI don't have a lot going on now, with retirement and all.
entries.zh: 毕竟都退休了,我现在也没什么事要忙。

entries.context: 玩家同意让 Gilbert 一起冒险
entries.text: Select an option: [Sure!]
entries.raw: §eSelect an option: §a[Sure!]
entries.zh: 请选择: [当然可以!]

entries.context: 玩家同意同行后，欣喜地回应
entries.text: Amazing.
entries.raw: §fAmazing.
entries.zh: 太好了。

entries.context: 同意同行后，想带上纪念品以记住故地
entries.text: Say, I would like a souvenir to take on my travels, though, to remember this place by.
entries.raw: §fSay, I would like a souvenir to take on my travels, though, to remember this place by.
entries.zh: 对了,我还想带个纪念品上路,留作对这地方的念想。

entries.context: 提出所需纪念品，请玩家钓起一个腰带扣
entries.text: If it's not too much trouble, might you be able to fish me up a Busted Belt Buckle?
entries.raw: §fIf it's not too much trouble, might you be able to fish me up a §9Busted Belt Buckle§f?
entries.gloss: 所需物品 Busted Belt Buckle 沿用本地整名译文破损的腰带扣：original_text/Fishing/GUI_Item/Collected_Names_September.json#name_busted_belt_buckle。保留钓起这一获取方式，不把此句改成购买。
entries.zh: 要是不麻烦的话,能帮我钓个破损的腰带扣吗?

segments.text: If it's not too much trouble, might you be able to fish me up a
segments.zh: 要是不麻烦的话,能帮我钓个

entries.context: 请求纪念品时，流露出对这座满是垃圾的岛的留恋
entries.text: As much of a dumping ground as this place is, it really feels like MY dumping ground, you know..?
entries.raw: §fAs much of a dumping ground as this place is, it really feels like MY dumping ground, you know..?
entries.gloss: MY 的大写强调归属感，用我自己的保留笑点与念旧情绪；原文没有额外粗体或颜色。
entries.zh: 这儿就算是个垃圾场,那也是我自己的垃圾场啊……你懂吧?

entries.context: 首次请求纪念品、未交付再次返回时均显示的 [GIVE ITEM]；复用已把括号和正文分别拆开的 CHAT 记录
没有交付物品就离开后，再次返回交谈
entries.text: Do you have that souvenir for me?
entries.raw: §fDo you have that souvenir for me?
entries.zh: 我的纪念品带来了吗?

entries.context: 未交付后再次返回，重申所需纪念品并提及以后可能需要回来
entries.text: I'm just looking for a Busted Belt Buckle in case I ever need to return here!
entries.raw: §fI'm just looking for a §9Busted Belt Buckle §fin case I ever need to return here!
entries.gloss: 所需物品沿用 original_text/Fishing/GUI_Item/Collected_Names_September.json#name_busted_belt_buckle 的破损的腰带扣。原文只提以后可能需要回来，不补传送、定位或消耗机制。
entries.zh: 我就想要个破损的腰带扣,说不定哪天还得回这儿呢!

segments.text: in case I ever need to return here!

entries.context: 未持有所需物品却选择交付时，提醒尚未拿到纪念品
entries.text: It appears you don't have my souvenir yet! It would be such a shame to leave without it...
entries.raw: §fIt appears you don't have my souvenir yet! It would be such a shame to leave without it...
entries.zh: 看来你还没拿到我的纪念品! 就这么走了,可真有点遗憾……

entries.context: 没有腰带扣却选择交付时，提示向 Junker Joel 获取物品
entries.text: Please could you get me a Busted Belt Buckle from Junker Joel?
entries.raw: §fPlease could you get me a §9Busted Belt Buckle §ffrom §2Junker Joel§f?
entries.gloss: 所需物品沿用 original_text/Fishing/GUI_Item/Collected_Names_September.json#name_busted_belt_buckle 的破损的腰带扣。Junker Joel 沿用废品商 Joel。本句保留页面的 from Junker Joel 获取提示，与前文 fish me up 并存，不擅自统一成另一种获取方式。
entries.zh: 能麻烦你去废品商 Joel 那儿帮我弄个破损的腰带扣吗?

segments.text: Please could you get me a

entries.context: 持有腰带扣并选择交付时，感谢玩家
entries.text: Amazing, thank you so much!
entries.raw: §fAmazing, thank you so much!
entries.zh: 太好了,真是太感谢你了!

entries.context: 收到纪念品后，准备去向其他船员自我介绍
entries.text: I'll go introduce myself to the rest of the crew!
entries.raw: §fI'll go introduce myself to the rest of the crew!
entries.gloss: 向其他船员作初次自我介绍，不补熟人关系。
entries.zh: 我去跟其他船员做个自我介绍!

entries.context: 交付成功后，以起航口号结束对话
entries.text: Anchors away!
entries.raw: §fAnchors away!
entries.gloss: 页面原文为 Anchors away!，不擅自改写成 Anchors aweigh!。
entries.zh: 起锚出发!

entries.context: 交付成功后的系统解锁横幅标题，不是 Gilbert 的发言；现有 CHAT 面无同文记录
entries.text: NEW ISLAND UNLOCKED!
entries.raw: §bNEW ISLAND UNLOCKED!
entries.gloss: 仅剥离 Wiki 横幅前导结构填充，完整样本保存在 wiki_raw_sample；正文单色不需 segments。引擎 LineShape 会保留服务器实际前导填充，layout 从实时原文判断，不由 Wiki 单个前导空格推断居中。
entries.zh: 新岛屿已解锁!

entries.context: 交付成功后的系统解锁横幅：岛名莲花环礁；不是 NPC 发言
entries.text: Lotus Atoll
entries.raw: §3Lotus Atoll
entries.gloss: Lotus Atoll 沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的莲花环礁。独立地点标签不能写成无自身词的纯占位符模板；现有 CHAT 面没有该整行。仅剥离前导结构填充，完整样本保存于 wiki_raw_sample，实际对齐由引擎处理。
entries.zh: 莲花环礁

entries.context: 交付成功后的系统解锁横幅：提示使用船舶导航器前往新解锁岛屿
entries.text: Open the Ship Navigator to travel to the %s!
entries.raw: §7Open the §6Ship Navigator §7to travel to the §3%s§7!
entries.wiki_raw_sample: §f  §7Open the §6Ship Navigator §7to travel to the §3Lotus Atoll§7!
entries.gloss: 岛名使用有类型模板，不逐岛枚举相同导航提示；本次 Wiki 样本为 Lotus Atoll，词表译莲花环礁。Ship Navigator 沿用已有船舶导航器。仅从匹配正文剥离前导结构填充，完整样本保存在 wiki_raw_sample，对齐从实时原文判断。
entries.zh: 打开船舶导航器,前往%s吧!

entries.context: 交付后、前往船上之前，表示稍后会登船会合
entries.text: I'll come and join you on the Ship shortly!
entries.raw: §fI'll come and join you on the §6Ship §fshortly!
entries.zh: 我很快就来船上和你会合!

segments.text: I'll come and join you on the

entries.context: 船上的随机闲聊：享受海风吹过头发的感觉
entries.text: I love the feel of the wind in my hair!
entries.raw: §fI love the feel of the wind in my hair!
entries.zh: 风吹过头发的感觉真舒服!

entries.context: 船上的随机闲聊：提醒玩家带上鱼竿；证据表此行未重复条件格，沿用 On the Ship
entries.text: I hope you brought your fishing rod!
entries.raw: §fI hope you brought your fishing rod!
entries.gloss: fishing rod 为泛指鱼竿，不是提出一个新的具名物品交付请求。
entries.zh: 你带鱼竿了吧?

entries.context: 船上的随机闲聊：喜欢海风中的咸味
entries.text: I love the taste of the salt in the air!
entries.raw: §fI love the taste of the salt in the air!
entries.zh: 空气里这股咸咸的味道,真让人喜欢!

entries.context: 船上的随机闲聊：期待钓到大东西
entries.text: I hope we catch something big!
entries.raw: §fI hope we catch something big!
entries.gloss: 只表达期待，不保证渔获大小。
entries.zh: 希望咱们能钓到个大家伙!

entries.context: 船上的随机闲聊：迫不及待想钓鱼
entries.text: I can't wait to catch some fish!
entries.raw: §fI can't wait to catch some fish!
entries.zh: 我都等不及要钓鱼了!

entries.context: 船上的随机闲聊：喜欢听海浪声
entries.text: I love the sound of the waves!
entries.raw: §fI love the sound of the waves!
entries.zh: 我可喜欢听海浪声了!
